news-horizon-094.title: Ingot Horizon 0.9.4: Parallel Chunk Meshing & Metal/Vulkan Parity
news-horizon-094.summary: Our Rust-native runtime cuts cold chunk upload latency by 42% and introduces unified frame pacing.
news-horizon-094.details: Horizon 0.9.4 ships lock-free staging buffers on Windows Vulkan, improved entity culling for dense redstone districts, and automatic profile migration from Java resource packs.

news-1215-snapshot.title: Snapshot 25w14a Brings New Ambient Fireflies & Fallen Logs
news-1215-snapshot.summary: Forest and swamp biomes gain atmospheric particle clusters and mossy fallen timber variants.
news-1215-snapshot.details: Test worlds created on 25w14a include toggleable Lodestone recipes and subtle leaf-fall particles beneath dense birch canopies.

news-modrinth-sync.title: Modrinth Dependency Resolver Now Caches Lockfiles Offline
news-modrinth-sync.summary: Export and share reproducible .ingotpack bundles with deterministic SHA-512 verification.
news-modrinth-sync.details: Team servers can pin exact transitive mod dependencies so every player joins with zero mismatch errors.

news-1214-patch.title: Java Edition 1.21.4 Hotfix Notes: Resin Bricks & Pale Garden Polish
news-1214-patch.summary: Fixes creaking heart light sensitivity edge cases and smooths winter lighting transitions.
news-1214-patch.details: Recommended upgrade for all Fabric 0.16.10 and NeoForge 21.4 survival worlds.
